BASE_ITER=5 (the stable shared-step config). TRAJECTORY (SSIM/hr): iter-1 K=10 0.2855/0.0; iter-2 K=30 0.2855/0.0 (depth FALSIFIED, byte-identical); iter-3 step=1e-8 0.8137/0.0 (LD-FBP PASSTHROUGH); iter-4 step=1e-5 share=F 0.6949/0.0 (per-step RUNAWAY into clamp); iter-5 step=1e-5 share=T 0.6074/0.0 (per-step runaway FIXED but LAMBDA RUNAWAY). BEST hr=0.0 all iters; best SSIM iter-3 0.8137 (pure passthrough). LIMITER (DECISIVE, from iter-5 SLURM log 765433): with tv_share_steps=True the step CONVERGED stable (~3.8e-4, no runaway) and loss flattened at 3.9e-5 (trained, stable) -- BUT the single shared LAMBDA EXPLODED monotonically 0.00123 (ep1) -> 0.119 (ep3) -> 1.328 (ep4) -> 2.527 (ep8), still climbing at the last epoch. At lambda~2.5 with step~3.8e-4 the TV term dominates the data term by orders of magnitude -> the K=30 unroll OVER-SMOOTHS -> SSIM 0.6074 / PSNR 26.84, FAR BELOW the 0.8137 FBP passthrough. The supervised-L2 loss TOLERATES the over-smoothing (3.9e-5 is a fine loss) while SSIM/PSNR collapse. The limiter is NO LONGER step scale (1e-5 is the active basin), NOR depth (falsified), NOR the per-step runaway (share=True killed it) -- it is the UNBOUNDED LAMBDA RUNAWAY under an outer lr that is 10x too aggressive for a 2-scalar log-parametrised optimizer over 8 epochs (lr=5e-2 was RAISED in iter-3/4 to UN-STICK frozen gradients in the share=False regime; it was NEVER LOWERED in the now-stable share=True 2-scalar regime, where it demonstrably over-drives log-lambda by 3 orders of magnitude). ONE KNOB CHANGED (from BASE_ITER=5): lr 0.05 -> 0.005 (10x DOWN). This is a GENUINELY-UNTRIED lever in the share=True regime -- lr-down on the stable 2-scalar config has never been run; it directly counters the observed lambda runaway. All else IDENTICAL to iter-5 (tv_share_steps=True, tv_step_init=1e-5 the confirmed active basin, tv_K=30, train_n=40, epochs=8, bs=1, tv_lambda_init=1e-3, tv_clip_max=0.05, tv_eps=1e-6, val_n=214 ALL L277, val_chunk=5, grad_clip=1.0). HYPOTHESIS: at lr=5e-3 the log-lambda optimizer no longer overshoots -- lambda settles in a moderate band (O(0.01-0.1)) where the K=30 GD balances data-consistency against TV instead of being TV-dominated, so the trained-stable TV recovers ABOVE the 0.8137 FBP passthrough and toward the classical non-trained tv_iterative band (SSIM 0.92 / hr 0.205). NUMERIC FALSIFIER (decisive): if SSIM stays <= 0.8137 with hr=0 -- this RETIRES THE LAST UNMAPPED LEVER and CONFIRMS the structural ceiling: supervised-unrolled-TV is FBP-BOUNDED on real Mayo 2304-view LDCT under the config-only contract -> file the NEGATIVE RESULT and STOP at iter-6. If hr>0, supervised-TV is repaired and iter-7 raises train_n (capacity tiny -- 2 scalars). BUDGET: IDENTICAL compute to iter-5 (~974s, ~226s margin under the 1200s wall). PREDICTED iter-6: SSIM ~0.80-0.88, hr most-likely 0.0 (structurally weak single-global-TV prior on a near-complete inverse); small chance hr 0.0-0.05.
